headline: As El Niño intensifies, Rio turns to science — and a spiritual adviser
context: This year's Super El Niño has brought unprecedented weather to Rio de Janeiro. Unaccustomed to tornado-strength winds, the city found an unusual partner to combat the weather: a spiritual adviser.

sources.name: NPR
